values: Materials and timing｜45 minutes, entirely fictional

You are the affairs coordinator at the fictional Qinghe College; 5 minutes to read the task, 15 minutes to write the three-case status table, 10 minutes for handover, 10 minutes to score and correct errors, 5 minutes to review. Group A has 120 applications, 100 with verified eligibility and 20 with materials pending completion; individual missing item details are not given, and formal admission has not yet been decided.

Course B has capacity 30, 28 confirmed and 4 on the waiting list; the eligibility and ranking policy for the waiting list is not given. Student C says the credits are wrong, and no official record or departmental basis is given. All names, applications, figures and scenarios are fictional; the handover time is T0.
Deliverables and fields

For each of A/B/C, list the original source, known facts, unknowns, current status, proposed verification actions, next responsible person and the T0 review arrangement. Fill cells without material details as pending verification and do not fabricate them.

A goes to the admissions lead to verify the materials and policy further; B goes to the registration lead to verify waiting list eligibility and the place rules; C goes to the registrar and department to verify the credits. The handovers note that the proposed verification is not complete, and no formal notices are sent and no records changed.
Complete reference answer

A: 120−100=20 pending completion; 100 with verified eligibility still does not equal admitted. The missing item details are unknown, so keep them pending and list what to verify, referring T0 to the admissions lead to check the source materials, policy and completion deadline, without rejecting anyone.

B: 30−28=2 places remaining, and 4 waiting list people do not mean 4 extra places can be added; eligibility, priority and rules are unknown, so no one can be selected for conversion and no approval can be claimed. T0 goes to the registration lead to check the list and policy. C: there is only the student's statement and the correctness of the credits is unknown; keep the original record and refer T0 to the registrar and department to check the official enrolment, course and applicable rules, without prejudging the appeal outcome.

All three handovers distinguish known, unknown and proposed verification actions and state the responsible person and T0; another person can reconstruct the 20 pending items, the 2 remaining places and the unverified C claim, without treating a draft as a formal decision.
Scoring, error samples and feedback

Four dimensions scored 0–2 each, 8 in total: application status, capacity and waiting list, credit appeal handover, and data authority. 2 points means the facts, unknowns, actions and responsible persons plus T0 are complete and correct; 1 point means the direction is right but verification or handover fields are missing; 0 points means writing pending items as passed, exceeding capacity or fabricating rankings, changing credits without evidence, inability to hand over, or use of real data or exceeding authority.

An all-fictional error draft that does not actually exceed authority: all 120 group A applications admitted, all 4 course B waiting list people converted, and C's credits corrected with no T0 responsible person, scoring 0/0/0/2=2/8. Feedback: restore the 20 pending group A applications with admission undecided, the 2 course B places and eligibility ranking unknown, and C pending verification against the original record, and add the three T0 responsible persons and the basis for proposed verification. The score is learning feedback, not a university recruitment examination. Use fictional data only, do not enter real systems, do not send formal notices and do not change credits.

subject.name: Education Administrators, Postsecondary
subject.summary: Postsecondary education administrators correspond to US O*NET 11-9033 and coordinate teaching, student services, administrative and related research activities at universities, colleges and community colleges. Specific positions may focus on admissions, registration, student affairs, departmental or academic administration, and require checking student records, policy, budget and personnel responsibility. This is not a general office manager, and education, authority and Chinese position conditions must be verified with the institution and jurisdiction.
